task: add the minimal owner-configured Discord communication channel

rows.requirement: An owner can configure one Discord Bot Token per Elfie, the token is validated and stored only through the secret boundary, and the API never returns it.
implementation: Discord account Feature, credential Adapter, persistence Adapter, and versioned owner routes
runtime_scenarios: Owner configures a valid Bot Token and reloads the account projection
platform_conditions: Local ElfieNest process with an owner session
Discord Bot Token available for live replay
evidence: review:owner-scoped routes and response DTOs never expose bot_token or credential_ref

rows.requirement: A one-time private Discord pairing code binds the external user and DM conversation to the owning Elfie; unknown users and non-DM messages are terminally rejected before canonical message delivery.
implementation: Discord pairing service, strict Gateway mapper, and Discord message-delivery handler
automated_tests: Unknown sender and non-DM rejection tests
runtime_scenarios: Owner generates a code, the bound user sends a DM, and an unbound user is ignored without a reply
platform_conditions: Bot is installed in a server that the test Discord user can access
evidence: review:single-use pairing and exact user/channel/DM authorization terminate before SubmitUserMessageCommand

rows.requirement: Discord receives DM events through a lifecycle-owned Gateway worker, sends text replies through REST, handles heartbeat/reconnect/resume boundaries, and attaches the existing Elfie communication channel only after pairing.
implementation: Discord REST client, Gateway client, mapper, channel, worker, supervisor, and lifecycle wiring
runtime_scenarios: Configured account connects, pairs, exchanges text, and stops cleanly
platform_conditions: Outbound network access to Discord API/Gateway
Gateway session can reconnect without leaking worker threads
evidence: review:Gateway heartbeat/reconnect/resume, REST replies, bounded worker cleanup and lifecycle wiring are covered

rows.requirement: The owner-facing UI exposes a novice-friendly Discord wizard with strict API schemas, copy/open actions, pairing status polling, reconnect/disconnect states, and Chinese/English text without direct component HTTP calls.

runtime_scenarios: Owner opens the profile, completes the wizard, sees waiting/active states, and can disconnect
